text_post: Wake Up and Smell the Diversity It's often hard to distinguish the fine aroma of "diversity" from the more common, though distinctly foul, odor of bovine excrement. The tide is turning. More and more the shit is hitting the fan and people are being forced to deal with the reality of the hateful Feminist blight which has so pervasively infused our corporate culture. Google is no exception, with it's ever faithful stream of "Woman Good, Man Bad" sewage spewed daily from every media orifice, it is just one of a growing list of companies who are abandoning all sense of equity and fairness and just blatantly foisting the hateful Feminist doctrine outright upon their workers. It's time to stop Feminism cold in its tracks.Call out its hateful, sexist proponents and their insidious activities wherever they are found. No longer turn away or shrug it off as "that crazy woman nonsense"-- Feminism is a real and present threat to social well-being and the values that so many people-- Men and Women alike-- share. Good wholesome values like love and caring and family-- are all being ground under in an ever-increasing ratcheting-effect of the Corporate-Feminist alliance, which amounts to little more than organized thuggery "wrapped in a pretty pink bow".  Women are wonderful-- what could be wrong with that? Surely nothing is wrong with that because women *ARE* wonderful. But so are men. This national push to emasculate men, to demonize masculinity, to tear down the male and render him forever impotent is misbegotten, ill-advised, and just fucking SEXIST AS HELL. One does not have to agree to or adopt hateful, sexist, divisive policies or politics-- such as hateful Feminism-- in order to believe and agree that Women are valuable and worthy partners in all areas of life. That is the LIE of Feminism-- that women for some reason can't be equal without it. It's time to call out Feminism for what it really is-- a HATE GROUP. With all of the same methods and goals as any other supremacist group. Their methods may be different, but their aims are just the same. And they are driven from the same ideological source-- HATRED and a smug sense of superiority. Women push men at their peril. Feminism exists only at the largess of men. If enough men wake up to the shit-stain which is Feminism, the blow-back will be enormous. Men love women and will do just about anything for them, which is why and how Feminism has been able to gain such enormous ground and funding. Men don't yet understand or realize the threat to them which is inherent in Feminism-- which has *ALWAYS* been inherent in Feminism, on purpose and by design, since its earliest days. There is nothing good about Feminism and nothing good about Feminists. Feminists are hateful, sexist people-- and Men are their targets. If anybody thinks differently, I invite them to show me the love for men by Feminists. Show me the great Feminist authors and their novels extolling the virtues of men. Show me the great Feminist orators thanking men and praising them for their many contributions to society. Show me the marches and rallies with all the Feminists coming together to express their love and adoration for men. Show me the songs, sonnets and love-poems that Feminists have written for men. Show men the vast cadres of Feminists busy toiling away to improve the lives of men and ease them of their burdens. Because that's what MEN have done for women since the dawn of time. If you don't think Feminism is about hate-- then show men the LOVE. Go ahead, I'll wait. Show me *ANYTHING* that Feminists have done for men altruistically simply because they're men-- something that doesn't surreptitiously benefit the Feminists themselves first and foremost. You can't do it because Feminism isn't about men. It isn't about equality. It's only about Women and female superiority. All their blather about "equality" and "equal rights" is simply so much shinola designed to confuse the weak-minded and gullible among us, so as to help disguise the true goals and nature of hateful Feminism. Feminism is a hate group. Feminists are hateful, sexist people. --- Reject Feminism. Embrace Humanity.
